title: Add shared print workflow for Trade Document Center
description: Connect Trade Document Center records to the repository's existing shared print preview, direct-print and print-design workflow. Reuse existing TradeDocument fields and print infrastructure; do not create document-detail schema, upload attachments, access production OSS, or perform deployment actions.
acceptance_criteria: Trade Document Center exposes user-visible print preview, direct-print and print-design actions through the existing shared print conventions.
The print data model maps existing document number, type, status, customer, order/container references, amount, currency, port, copies, dates and notes without inventing unavailable values.
Unavailable fields render as blank or explicitly unavailable and do not trigger heuristic lookups or text-only authoritative matches.
Print configuration and design lists do not introduce duplicate registrations or break existing quotation, PI or order print workflows.
Unit/integration tests cover print-model mapping, missing optional values, action wiring and duplicate-registration protection; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open an existing Trade Document record and verify its shared print preview contains the persisted references and values.
Open print design from Trade Document Center and verify the document type is registered once without affecting another printable document.

human_gate.reason: Uses existing local print and document-center application infrastructure only; no OSS upload, production mutation, deployment or release.
